name: Music video
description: Generate a music bed, then three visual moods that animate into clips — assemble them in a playlist.

nodes.title: Music bed
nodes.prompt: dreamy synthwave, 100 bpm, warm pads, driving bassline

nodes.title: Visual language
nodes.prompt: Retro-futurist night drive, neon magenta and cyan, VHS grain, lens bloom

nodes.title: Mood 1
nodes.prompt: Empty highway through a desert at night under a huge moon

nodes.title: Mood 2
nodes.prompt: Driver silhouette lit by dashboard neon

nodes.title: Mood 3
nodes.prompt: City skyline glowing on the horizon

nodes.title: Clip 1
nodes.prompt: fast tracking shot along the road

nodes.title: Clip 2
nodes.prompt: slow push-in, lights sweeping across the face

nodes.title: Clip 3
nodes.prompt: aerial drone rise toward the skyline
